purpose: Track monsoon low-pressure systems consistently in CMIP6 historical and future integrations and expose model-aware climate-change diagnostics in the atlas.

minimum_candidate_fields.circulation: ua+va or vo at 850, 700 and 500 hPa at no worse than six-hour cadence
minimum_candidate_fields.pressure: mean sea-level pressure at no worse than six-hour cadence

processing_rules: Preserve each model's exact elapsed-time and native-calendar identity; use cftime at ingestion and an invertible ordinal analysis clock only where the frozen detector requires pandas timestamps.
Run a month-scale field and timestep QA pilot before a model is admitted.
Use one frozen detector/linker version across historical and scenario segments.
Join historical and scenario segments only for the same model, member and compatible grid.
Use a common one-degree analysis grid and a fixed ERA5 land mask and orography so geography does not vary by model.

Bilinearly sample common-grid 10-m wind onto a 0.25-degree calculation mesh before the frozen 125-km P95 circulation-wind operator; record that this stabilises the percentile but adds no source information.
Store raw detector diagnostics so resolution sensitivity can be audited.
Do not tune thresholds to force agreement with ERA5 counts; report model biases separately.

comparison_defaults.ensemble_weighting: one model, one vote by default; member-weighted view optional
comparison_defaults.uncertainty: show model spread and paired historical-to-scenario changes

engineering_pilot.status: standardisation, frozen detector/linker, final-centre physics, classification and compact seasonal publication asset completed
engineering_pilot.interpretation: Engineering canary only; one season per climate is not a climate-change estimate.

native_calendar_canary.status: field standardisation, frozen tracking, final-centre physics, native-time inversion QA and compact staging completed
native_calendar_canary.time_identity: Continuous native elapsed hours are exposed to the unchanged detector on an ordinal analysis clock; exact native dates are restored in the final catalogue without adding, dropping or stretching model days.
native_calendar_canary.pressure_sampling: Both halves use HadGEM3-GC31-LL 6hrPlev interval-mean MSLP because SSP2-4.5 has no instantaneous 6hrPlevPt MSLP; source cell methods are retained in provenance.
native_calendar_canary.interpretation: Engineering canary only; admission to the ensemble still requires the complete historical realism screen.

first_production_pair.status: complete and staged for scientific review
first_production_pair.publication_gate: The browser tab remains hidden until the multi-model scientific review is explicitly approved.

initial_multi_model_review.finding: MIROC6 alone passes the conservative all-LPS historical screen and no model passes the all-month plus JJAS absolute classification screen. JJAS system-count changes split two increases to three decreases, whereas all five models increase mean peak 24-hour precipitation.
initial_multi_model_review.next_gate: Complete the ERA5-as-model common-grid control and precipitation-impact diagnostics; keep absolute D/DD/CS changes out of headline inference until category realism improves.

prepublication_gates: Run at least the 1981-2010 and 2071-2100 windows for every admitted model/scenario pair.
Apply common-grid final-centre wind, pressure-deficit and actual closed-isobar intensity classification using a common land mask.
Quantify 1-degree versus native-grid sensitivity for a representative high-resolution model.
Run ERA5 itself through the common 1-degree input contract to isolate detector resolution effects.
Validate Gregorian, no-leap and 360-day calendar identity without mapping nonexistent dates into civil time.
Report historical frequency and intensity biases against ERA5 separately from projected paired changes.
planned_controls: frequency, duration, intensity, pathway and rainfall metric
publication_assets: precomputed spatial density and rainfall-change grids
